description:
Break language barriers instantly with AI Translator – your all-in-one tool for voice, text, and screen translation.

Whether you are traveling the world, conducting international business, or learning a new language, this app provides high-speed, AI-powered accuracy in the palm of your hand. No more language confusion—just seamless communication in over 100 languages.

🔍 Core Features for Every Scenario
Our toolkit is designed to handle real-life communication challenges, ensuring you stay connected whether you are online or offline.

🎙️ Tap to Speak (Voice Translation)
Speak naturally and get instant translations. Perfect for ordering food in Italy, chatting with a driver in Japan, or having real-time conversations with locals anywhere. It turns your phone into a professional interpreter.

📲 Screen Translator (Translate on Any App)
Translate text directly on your mobile screen. Whether you are browsing foreign websites, reading social media posts, or using apps in another language, our screen overlay works like magic without needing to switch apps.

🗨️ Phrase Dialogue (Travel Essentials)
Quickly access curated phrases for travel, shopping, hotels, and emergencies. Be confident in every interaction, even if you are just starting to learn the language.

📘 Smart Dictionary
Go beyond simple translation. Look up word definitions, synonyms, and example sentences to understand the deeper context and improve your vocabulary every day.

🌍 Why Use AI Translator?
Fast & Reliable: Powered by advanced AI for natural-sounding results.

100+ Languages: From English and Spanish to Vietnamese and Arabic.

User-Centric: Clean interface designed for speed and ease of use.

🔹Accessibility Service (Necessary)
Our app uses the AccessibilityService API to assist users in capturing text displayed on their screen from other applications. This enables seamless translation of content into the user's preferred language in real time.

We are committed to protecting user privacy. The app does not collect, store, or share any personal or sensitive data. All processed information is used solely to provide the translation feature and is not retained or transmitted externally.

🚀 Ready to speak the world's language? Download AI Translator now and start communicating without limits!
